ohtani.title: Betts, Hernández lift Dodgers to extra-inning win
ohtani.blurb: Enrique Hernández tallies three RBIs and Mookie Betts brings across two of his own as the Dodgers defeat the Rockies 6-4 in extra innings

imanaga.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits two homers in Cubs' win
imanaga.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits a walk-off and leadoff homer, and Shota Imanaga strikes out 10 in the Cubs' 7-5 win over the White Sox

suzuki.title: Montgomery, Urquidy power White Sox in 3-0 win
suzuki.blurb: Braden Montgomery hits a late two-run double and José Urquidy throws six shutout innings, leading the White Sox to a 3-0 win over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Five-run 4th inning propels Rays' win vs. Blue Jays
okamoto.blurb: The Rays combine for five runs in the 4th inning, plus Yandy Díaz crushes a two-run homer in Tampa Bay's 7-6 win over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Montgomery, Urquidy power White Sox in 3-0 win
murakami.blurb: Braden Montgomery hits a late two-run double and José Urquidy throws six shutout innings, leading the White Sox to a 3-0 win over the Cubs

matsui.title: Carson Benge, Robert Stock lift Mets to a 4-2 victory
matsui.blurb: Carson Benge crushes a two-run home run in the 4th inning and Robert Stock strikes out six to lead the Mets to a 4-2 victory over the Padres
